notes: Read the full 1307-line source line by line before editing. Imports L1-11 are all browser/web-coupled and were re-homed: react useId/useContext/useMemo kept (useContext dropped — the TwinContext was only an SVG-internal plumbing convenience and is replaced by explicit props); framer-motion L2 (motion.*/AnimatePresence) has no native analogue in this dependency set so every animation is rendered as a static 'active' visual emphasis (HelixMark/AreaChartWrapper precedent); lucide Lock/Unlock/Shield L3 -> native 🔒/🔓/🛡 glyphs; cn L4 dropped (className kept but ignored as _className); Tooltip L5 -> accessibilityLabel + always-visible status list; the @/lib/vehicleState types L6, @/lib/vehicleColors FALLBACK_PAINT/PaintPalette L7-10, and @/hooks/useVehiclePaint L11 are inlined verbatim (those modules are not yet ported) so the port is self-contained.

Constants L13-20 ported: SIZE_MAP {sm:300,md:440,lg:560}, VIEWBOX_WIDTH 560, VIEWBOX_MIN_Y 52, VIEWBOX_HEIGHT 220, ASPECT_RATIO, and exported VehicleTwinSize. DRIVE_IN_DURATION (L18) only timed the framer-motion drive-in slide/wheel-spin/light-sweep which are unavailable natively, so the numeric constant is intentionally not reproduced (documented in a code comment); the driveIn prop still drives the static headlight/taillight/wheel emphasis.

VehicleTwinProps L22-45 ported and exported, extending the inlined VehicleTwinState; size/interactive/driveIn/className/vehicleId/exteriorColor/paint preserved with the same JSDoc intent, plus native style/testID/data-testid/aria-hidden compatibility props (VehiclePicker/HelixMark precedent). The @/lib/vehicleColors PaintPalette/PaintPaletteId (vehicleColors L27-61), PAINT_PALETTES (L67-228, all 5 stock paints verbatim), FALLBACK_PAINT (L244), inferPaintFromTesla (L255-268) and isPaintPaletteId (L274-276) are inlined; vehicleState DoorStates/WindowState/TurnSignalState/VehicleTwinState (vehicleState L8-15,104,129,144-163) are inlined as exported types.

TwinIds/buildTwinIds L47-96 and SvgDefs L1076-1177 (shadowBlur/glow filters + bodyGrad/lowerShadow/hood/frontDoor/rearDoor/quarter/rocker/mirror/shoulder/softReflection/glass/headlightLens/rim/rimDepth/tireOuter gradients) existed solely to give each twin its own collision-free <defs> id set; React Native has no <defs>, so the id machinery and useId() are SVG-only and omitted. The gradient color stops are folded into native fills: bodyGrad->paint.swatch + paint.body[0]/[3] overlays, glassGrad->GLASS_CLOSED, rim/tire->slate/near-black wheel layers.

TwinContext/useTwinCtx L98-118 dropped (the paint/ids/bodyAccent context is passed explicitly via props to the native sub-components instead). The C static color map L120-156 is ported verbatim and used for window/door/light/lock/charge/seat fills and strokes. windowFill/windowStroke/windowLabel/doorStroke/stateLabel L158-193 ported verbatim (the glassClosedRef url(#...) becomes the concrete GLASS_CLOSED color); added turnSignalLabel/formatLastUpdated/windowTone/doorTone/toneColor helpers for the status list.

InteractiveHotspot L195-221 (foreignObject + Tooltip span) is browser-only; the hotspot label strings are preserved and attached as accessibilityLabel on the matching native indicator (BodyShell frunk/trunk, SideWindows FD/RD, DoorOverlay, ChargePortIndicator, SecurityOverlay) plus surfaced in the status list, all gated by the same interactive prop.

useVehiclePaint (web hook L112-188): resolution order override>inferred>fallback, the inferred memo, setPaint normalization (id===inferred.id -> null), reset, and in-tab live updates are ported. The browser-only persistence — localStorage readOverride/writeOverride (hook L74-97), the window 'storage' listener (L146-155), and the cross-tab broadcast bus (L135-142) — is unavailable in native and replaced by an in-memory per-vehicle override Map + listener registry (mirrors the hook's notifyInTab/subscribeInTab), documented as a native-safe adaptation. The main component only reads .paint, so this is render-equivalent.

Gates run in apps/native and all pass: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit, exit 0), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint . --quiet, exit 0 — only react-native/no-inline-styles warnings remain, suppressed by --quiet, matching the AreaChartWrapper dynamic-style precedent), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (19 suites / 88 tests passed). A temporary react-test-renderer smoke test verified the component mounts for resting, charging/driving, and null/unknown door+window edge states (including DeepBlueMetallic paint inference and interactive a11y labels) and was removed before commit. Only apps/native changes are committed.
